|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker) (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V8-D-hothiceplains-2022-07-10.png]]). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V8-D-hothiceplains-2022-07-10-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V8-D-hothiceplains-2018-07-08.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V8-D-hothiceplains-2022-07-10-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V8-D-hothiceplains-2022-07-10.png]], 10 July 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints no errata mark, but this is errata 1 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker) (V)]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-hothiceplains022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/hothiceplains.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual8-Dark/large/hothiceplains.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker)”. Text: “'''Light Side:''' Ice Storm is canceled at Hoth sites. '''Dark Side:''' Once per game, may exchange an Interrupt from hand with bottom card of your Reserve Deck.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 10 July 2022<ref name="img-hothiceplains6489b69">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/hothiceplains.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769 commit 6489b69] (10 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual8-Dark/large/hothiceplains.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the bottom margin “Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker)” → “Hoth: Ice Plains”; the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (490×350 → 1039×745 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Hoth: Ice Plains”. Text: “'''Light Side:''' Ice Storm is canceled at Hoth sites. '''Dark Side:''' Once per game, may exchange an Interrupt from hand with bottom card of your Reserve Deck.”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker) (V) (Errata 2)]]): PC card image uploaded 30 August 2022<ref name="img-hothiceplains3515e91">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/hothiceplains.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3515e91b0f5636658fca65b3ec5bc7d79d105a8f commit 3515e91] (30 August 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual8-Dark/large/hothiceplains.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' “Light Side: Ice Storm is canceled at Hoth sites. Dark Side:” → “Dark Side:”; “Reserve Deck.” → “Reserve Deck. Ice Storm is canceled at Hoth sites.”; the errata mark “E1” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “Hoth: Ice Plains”. It is the current image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “'''Dark Side:''' Once per game, may exchange an Interrupt from hand with bottom card of your Reserve Deck. Ice Storm is canceled at Hoth sites.”
